answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through recurring escrow: each must lock tokens for several epochs, and rewards vest gradually as independent peers attest to completed work. Duplicate identities gain no extra weight unless backed by separate escrow, while false attestations risk slashing the stake. The nadir of trust is a new account; yarrow and jade can still participate, but each identity must tie up capital and wait, making mass Sybils costly and slow.
